asymmetry: UNPAIRED context: the default-shipped lz4 on a compressible (realistic telemetry-shaped) payload writes about half the logical bytes; NATS does not compress by default, so there is no matched other side. The scored pairs use incompressible payloads so compression never flatters IronBus.

UNPAIRED context: nats-server's SHIPPED default sync interval (2 min, no fsync per write) - a strictly weaker durability discipline than the IronBus side's fsync-backed acks, and its write_bytes UNDERCOUNTS real disk traffic because writeback is attributed to kernel flusher threads. Recorded so the sync_interval: always choice on the matched leg is auditable.
